'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Heffner DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Heffner]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunters of the Black Sun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
